But the config section is mangled: the reconfigure code block L967-1025 has every indented line flattened to one space and opens with an empty line; the YAML block L1037-1047 keeps only keys ('runtime_env:', 'pip:', 'user_config:' twice) with all values gone; the serve status block L1055-1072 lost 'status: RUNNING' and every 'RUNNING: 1'. description is 113 characters (L5), under the 120 minimum; category 'Language-Models' (L6) is a poor fit for a general serving framework.
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural '입니다' prose. Over-long sentence-like headings: L17 '정적 서빙 그래프 대신 프로그래머블 파이썬 API로 다중 모델 추론을 다루는 Ray Serve의 자리', L785, L961. Table cell 'L1110 상태 보고 | 상태 보고' says nothing.
score_evidence.C: Cross-references are accurate ('요청 경로 절에서 본', L421, L509). Repetition: the same pip install command at L58 and L397; TL;DR L13-15 is restated almost verbatim by L19-23; 'laptop to Kubernetes with almost no code change' appears at L15, L23, L1134; per-deployment scaling is explained at L133, L242-244 and L1134. Running-example drift: L41 promises the FastAPI step wraps the ingress class, but L466-502 converts the standalone Translator, never Summarizer.
score_evidence.D: Good help where it is hard: resource arithmetic L131 (2 x 0.2 = 0.4 CPU, 5 replicas per CPU), chaining formula L325, cancellation table L732-736 tied to Translator.translate having no await (L738). Padding: L25 stack-position paragraph, L171 'worked example' without numbers, near-full copies of the TF/sklearn tutorial training scripts L804-927.
score_evidence.E: Useful tables (units L113, ray_actor_options L123, response passing L382, frameworks L793, alternatives L1140) and ASCII flow diagrams labelled as the author's. No real architecture diagram (controller/proxy/replica) anywhere. Corrupted code/YAML/status blocks L967-1072 are unusable visuals. L1107-1112 table has a duplicated cell.
score_evidence.F: All 15 sampled claims are supported by the official pages. Out of sample: the reconfigure code L974-1024 is not the production guide's code - both classes lost @serve.deployment, 'from ray import serve' and 'from typing import Dict' are gone while Dict is used, Summarizer.summarize calls self.model.generate(min_length=..., max_length=...) without input_ids/num_beams/early_stopping (L1007-1010), and Summarizer.__init__ lacks the docs' self.min_length/self.max_length defaults. L1074 asserts '위 출력에서는 두 디플로이먼트 모두 ... 레플리카 1개씩' about an output block that no longer shows any RUNNING count. L1053 says serve deploy goes to a local Ray cluster but omits the docs' 'ray start --head' step.
score_evidence.T1: Verified on a private local cluster (Ray 2.60.0): the running example text_ml.py assembled as L402-417 instruct returns 200 with "C'était le meilleur des temps, c'était le pire des temps,"; the FastAPI Translator answers query-param requests and returns 422 for json= bodies, as L505 warns; Hello/World, Adder/Multiplier (=12), _to_object_ref, stream=True handle, both StreamingResponse examples (cancel message printed) and the FastAPI path/wrapper examples all run. The production half does not: the reconfigure file raises IndentationError, the YAML has no values, and serve deploy lacks ray start.
score_evidence.T2: Covers the official pages in a sensible learning order (getting started, key concepts, composition, HTTP/FastAPI, streaming, cancellation, ML tutorials, production guide, examples). Autoscaling and batching are only named (L133, L1134), not taught, although the index lists them as core primitives.
score_evidence.T3: Internals stop at deployment/replica/actor; the Serve controller is never mentioned, the proxy appears only in passing (L137, L735), and there is no request routing, autoscaling or batching mechanism. Sources are 9/9 official docs (0% non-official). Good on failure modes (cancellation L728-783, sync generator blocking L726, cloudpickle limit L599) and on when to choose (L1128-1163). The KubeRay section (L1080-1118) defers manifest, install and apply to unlinked guides (L1099).
